text: Half-sunk in red river silt stands a boundary milestone carved with the First Compact's crossed hammers. Tarnished copper coins glint inside its mossy offering bowl.

choices.label: Clean the moss and leave 25 gold.
choices.outcome: The stone warms briefly; your vanguard marches steadier through the mud.

choices.label: Pry the copper coins from the bowl.
choices.outcome: You pocket 45 gold, though cold river-fog clings to your boots.

text: Around a smokeless charcoal pit sit three shivering militia deserters roasting turnips. One wears a stolen Thornwick corporal's sash.

choices.label: Conscript them back into your vanguard.
choices.outcome: Grumbling, they shoulder their pikes and fall in behind your banner.

choices.label: Confiscate their rations and let them run.
choices.outcome: You gain dry hardtack and 30 gold in unpaid levy scrip.

text: Face-down in duckweed lies a royal dispatch rider pinned by three green-fletched gnoll shafts. His waterproofed leather satchel is still buckled tight.

choices.label: Cut open the satchel for intel and coin.
choices.outcome: You recover troop maps and 65 gold, inhaling a whiff of marsh-rot.

choices.label: Bury him under stones and keep his boots.
choices.outcome: Properly witnessed, the dead leave decent calfskin behind.

text: A one-wheeled tinker's cart sits wedged in an alder ditch while its owner argues with a mule. He offers salvaged border iron at half price to lighten his load.

choices.label: Buy his crate of tempered arrowheads (60g).
choices.outcome: Crisp bodkins restock your quivers and bolster ranged morale.

choices.label: Help haul his wheel out of the ditch.
choices.outcome: Grateful, he presses a Healing Draught and 20 gold into your palm.

text: The iron-caged lanterns ahead gutter out simultaneously as loose slate clatters down both canyon walls. Crossbow clicks echo from the dark ledges.

choices.label: Charge straight up the gorge with shields.
choices.outcome: Bruised by ricochets, your vanguard scatters the cutthroats and loots their camp.

choices.label: Fall back and smoke them out with pitch.
choices.outcome: No blood spilled, though burning your last oil flask costs supplies.

text: Beneath a collapsed abbey arch rests a lead-sealed reliquary etched with pre-imperial warning glyphs. A faint blue hum vibrates through the flagstones.

choices.label: Crack the lead seal with a crowbar.
choices.outcome: Static shocks your knuckles, revealing an intact Mana Draught and silver.

choices.label: Copy the warning glyphs for Marta.
choices.outcome: Neat charcoal rubbings earn scholarly praise and experience.

text: Smoke curls from a collapsed cellar beneath a burned border farmstead. Half-charred sacks of seed-corn lie beside a locked iron strongbox.

choices.label: Smash the lock and take the tax silver.
choices.outcome: You haul out 90 gold in melted Border Mint coin.

choices.label: Salvage the seed-corn for Thornwick refugees.
choices.outcome: Garrick's outriders salute your restraint; morale rises.

text: An old charcoal-burner tends a smoking clay kiln in a Greywood hollow, boiling willow-bark salve in a dented helmet.

choices.label: Trade 35 gold for two jars of willow-salve.
choices.outcome: The bitter paste knits blisters and restores company vigor.

choices.label: Share campfire news of the northern roads.
choices.outcome: He warns you of hidden Briar Hound dens ahead.

text: A stone cistern ringed by bleached cattle skulls holds three inches of clear rainwater beneath a cracked desert-saint relief.

choices.label: Fill canteens and leave a silver offering.
choices.outcome: Cool water revives your parched vanguard.

choices.label: Drain the cistern dry for your mules.
choices.outcome: Your column marches faster, though locals curse your greed.

text: Out of copper dust steps a salt-crusted peddler leading two gaunt pack-lizards loaded with contraband quarry iron and warm vinegar.

choices.label: Buy a flask of Greater Healing Draught (85g).
choices.outcome: Thick red-cap moss tonic restores battle-worn veterans.

choices.label: Threaten to report his contraband to Bram.
choices.outcome: He pays 110 gold in hush-money and vanishes into the dunes.

text: Wind-scoured sandstone reveals a Third-Dynasty burial niche sealed with black bitumen. Golden funeral scales glint behind a lattice of dry femurs.

choices.label: Pry out the golden probate scales.
choices.outcome: Worth 160 gold, though bitter mummy-dust burns your lungs.

choices.label: Recite a witness prayer and leave the seal.
choices.outcome: A quiet chill steadies your casters' focus.

text: Bone wind-chimes shriek overhead as sand-clan skirmishers roll boulders down the narrow granite notch to split your baggage train.

choices.label: Anchor shields and push through the dust.
choices.outcome: Bruised ribs, yet you scatter the ambushers and seize their bows.

choices.label: Detour along the steep goat-ledge.
choices.outcome: Slow and exhausting, but your wagons escape unscathed.

text: Beside a dry alkali pan lies an escaped quarry miner still wearing half an iron ankle-chain, clutching a fist-sized lump of raw star-metal.

choices.label: Take the star-metal and bury him in cairn-stone.
choices.outcome: The dense ore fetches 145 gold from Ironheart smiths.

choices.label: Search his rags for hidden overseer keys.
choices.outcome: You find a tarnished bronze ring and brass tally-tags.

text: Three off-duty Redmarsh outriders dice over a dried viper-skin while boiling bitter desert-thorn tea over dung embers.

choices.label: Wager 75 gold on their bone-dice game.
choices.outcome: Loaded dice or luck—you walk away 150 gold richer.

choices.label: Pay 50 gold for their trail-maps of the basin.
choices.outcome: Marked water-holes save your vanguard days of marching.

text: A fractured quartz boundary pillar hums violently, arcing blue sparks into a ring of glassed sand.

choices.label: Ground the spire with an iron pike.
choices.outcome: A sharp shock numbs your arm, leaving behind charged quartz.

choices.label: Channel mana into the fissure to stabilize it.
choices.outcome: The hum quiets into a steady harmonic chime.

text: Half-swallowed by rust-red mire sits an overturned supply cart from an earlier column, guarded by bloated carrion-crows.

choices.label: Haul out the waterproofed bolt-crates.
choices.outcome: You salvage 120 gold worth of steel-tipped quarrels.

choices.label: Burn the cart to deny raiders the timber.
choices.outcome: Black smoke rises cleanly; your scouts gain tactical insight.

text: In a fog-shrouded sea-cave below the cliffs, a hooded Oakhaven pilot unloads barrels of waterproofed Greek fire from a black skiff.

choices.label: Buy siege pitch and charts for 180 gold.
choices.outcome: Naval schematics give your marines an edge on the piers.

choices.label: Seize the contraband in Oakhaven's name.
choices.outcome: The pilot flees into the surf, leaving 240 gold behind.

text: At low tide, a barnacle-crusted bronze bell protrudes from the shingle, humming a low note whenever waves wash over its rim.

choices.label: Strike the bell once with a sword-pommel.
choices.outcome: Cold sea-mist clears your casters' minds; spirits stir.

choices.label: Chip off the silver liturgical fittings.
choices.outcome: You pry loose 210 gold in salt-pitted silver.

text: A tilted First-Empire bronze door stands wedged half-open by a snapped oak beam while cold Atlantic swell laps at the threshold.

choices.label: Wade in before the tide turns.
choices.outcome: Freezing water chills your bones, but you haul out a relic ring.

choices.label: Leave the flooded vault to the crabs.
choices.outcome: Dry boots and steady lungs keep your squad sharp.

text: Fog parts suddenly on the coastal switchbacks, revealing six Ironclad arbalestiers cranking steel prods from a stone redoubt above.

choices.label: Rush the blind spot beneath the cliff.
choices.outcome: Two bolts graze your shields before you clear the ledge.

choices.label: Pin them with smoke and counter-volleys.
choices.outcome: Clean tactical withdrawal with minimal bruises.

text: Wedged between basalt reefs lies a bloated paymaster in gold-braided coat, chained by the wrist to an ironbound sea-chest.

choices.label: Hack the chain and haul the chest ashore.
choices.outcome: Inside sit 310 gold crowns stamped with royal anchors.

choices.label: Unclasp his salt-corroded astrolabe.
choices.outcome: The brass rings still turn true toward the southern straits.

text: Three wounded Oakhaven marines huddle beneath a stretched sailcloth tarp, boiling sea-kelp over a driftwood fire.

choices.label: Share medical supplies and 90 gold for transport.
choices.outcome: They pledge their blades to your harbor assault.

choices.label: Rest beside their fire and trade rations.
choices.outcome: Warm broth and dry wool mend 40 HP across your squad.

text: A shattered geomancer's pillar hisses white steam above Oakhaven's timber valley, surrounded by panes of fused fumarole glass.

choices.label: Harvest the sterile glass panes for Sera.
choices.outcome: Sharp edges nick your gloves, earning 220 gold from surgeons.

choices.label: Topple the cracked stone to seal the vent.
choices.outcome: The ground cools immediately; your vanguard breathes easier.

text: An ancient First-Watch anvil stands bolted into black obsidian, weeping faint golden sparks where meteoric slag meets cold ash.

choices.label: Lay your blade across the warm iron.
choices.outcome: Banked ember tempers your steel; your squad gains vigor.

choices.label: Pry loose the meteoric slag-ingots.
choices.outcome: Worth 450 gold at Vok's forge, though hot ash blisters your palms.

text: Huddled inside a basalt cleft, a soot-masked apostate offers forbidden leyline elixirs salvaged from Malrik's abandoned camp.

choices.label: Buy an Elixir of Mind for 320 gold.
choices.outcome: Clear starlight sharpens your casters' focus permanently.

choices.label: Confiscate his stolen Ironcamp rations.
choices.outcome: You recover 380 gold in garrison coin and healing draughts.

text: A toppled iron golem blocks half the magnetic canyon, its chest cavity still pulsing with a cracked crimson capacitor core.

choices.label: Extract the capacitor core carefully.
choices.outcome: Arcane backlash scorches your vanguard, yielding 480 gold.

choices.label: Collapse the cliff-scree over the husk.
choices.outcome: Clean tactical cover secures the canyon flank.

text: Four blind penitents kneel around an iron brazier of grey ash, reciting the names of the First Watch from memory.

choices.label: Add your fallen mercenaries' names to the roll.
choices.outcome: A solemn calm settles over the company, restoring morale.

choices.label: Trade 150 gold for consecrated ash-wards.
choices.outcome: Smearing the grey ash on plate blunts demonic fire.

text: Yellow sulfur crust splits open ahead as three Cinderhorns erupt from magma-veined trenches, swinging white-hot chains.

choices.label: Hold tight shield-wall and counter with frost.
choices.outcome: Heavy dents in your plate, yet the fiends shatter into slag.

choices.label: Disengage across the basalt ridge.
choices.outcome: You avoid the magma vents at the cost of trailing supplies.

text: Slumped against a shattered Anchor Seal sits a Dread Knight whose black armor has fused shut around his collarbone.

choices.label: Pry off his signet ring with a quarry-pick.
choices.outcome: You claim a heavy Bloodstone Pendant and 410 gold.

choices.label: Leave the cursed plate untouched.
choices.outcome: Prudence spares your hands from lingering hex-fire.

text: Behind a collapsed basalt merlon lies an intact Ironcamp pioneer cache packed with quenched bolts and vulcanized oil-flasks.

choices.label: Distribute the gear across your squads.
choices.outcome: Fresh steel and bandages restore 45 HP and boost readiness.

choices.label: Sell the surplus to Rowan's quartermaster.
choices.outcome: You pocket 440 gold immediately.

text: Half-buried in the riverbank silt lies a splintered oak toll-chest bound with rusted iron straps, its brass padlock hanging sheared in two.

choices.label: Sift through the wet mud inside the chest.
choices.outcome: You salvage tarnished silver coins wedged beneath swollen ledger pages.

choices.label: Smash the iron bindings free for scrap.
choices.outcome: The heavy straps yield clean bog-iron fittings useful for reinforcing shields.

text: As your vanguard nears a narrow willow-lined bend, three fletched arrows thud into the mud ahead while rough voices demand a crossing toll from the reeds.

choices.label: Charge straight into the brush with shields raised.
choices.outcome: Your sudden rush scatters the brigands, leaving behind their dropped coin-purse and bowstrings.

choices.label: Toss a small pouch of silver onto the gravel and march past.
choices.outcome: The brigands snatch the bribe and let your company cross the ford unharmed.

choices.label: Feign retreat to draw them onto open ground.
choices.outcome: Outnumbered on the bare shingle, the highwaymen drop their spears and flee.

text: A weathered stone altar dedicated to the River Shepherd stands beside an eddy, its basin choked with dead leaves and tangled fishing line.

choices.label: Clear the basin and offer a ration of dry bread.
choices.outcome: A calm breeze parts the river mist, lifting the fatigue from your company's limbs.

choices.label: Take the bronze offering ladle from the niche.
choices.outcome: You pocket the tarnished metal, though an icy chill settles deep into your boots.

text: A limping border courier leans against a milestone, clutching a blood-soaked leather dispatch satchel and glancing nervously back toward Alder Bridge.

choices.label: Bind his leg with clean linen and share water.
choices.outcome: Grateful, he marks safe ford-crossings on your map and hands over a spare purse.

choices.label: Demand his dispatch satchel before leaving him.
choices.outcome: Inside you find royal scrip and troop orders, though the courier curses your name.

text: Beneath the collapsed timbers of an old timber palisade, a cellar trapdoor lies half-covered by thorny briars and fallen thatch.

choices.label: Pry open the trapdoor and search the cellar.
choices.outcome: You uncover waxed crates of dry hardtack and salted pork untouched by the rain.

choices.label: Leave the unstable timbers undisturbed.
choices.outcome: You bypass the ruin safely without risking a collapse.

text: Two off-duty Thornwick pikemen sit beside a low peat fire by the riverbank, boiling river-crawfish in a dented iron helmet.

choices.label: Share stories and trade news of the border roads.
choices.outcome: Warm food and tactical warnings sharpen your company's readiness for the march ahead.

choices.label: Buy their spare whetstones and lantern oil.
choices.outcome: You part with a few coins for well-kept supplies.

text: A merchant's wain lies tipped onto its side in a muddy ditch, one axle snapped and its canvas cover torn open to the drizzle.

choices.label: Haul the salvageable crates out of the mire.
choices.outcome: Straining through the mud yields bolts of dry wool and a small strongbox.

choices.label: Strip the dry oak planks for firewood.
choices.outcome: A brisk campfire dries out your company's sodden cloaks.

text: Seven pale green marsh-lights hover motionless over a ring of sunken standing stones, illuminating a skull filled with dark bog-water.

choices.label: Pour salt into the skull to break the lure.
choices.outcome: The lights snuff out with a sharp hiss, revealing tarnished rings in the peat beneath.

choices.label: Step into the ring and peer into the black water.
choices.outcome: Visions of hidden paths flash through your mind, though cold fever numbs your fingers.

text: Protruding from a bank of black peat is the corner of a lead-lined paymaster's coffer, chained to the skeleton of a long-drowned knight.

choices.label: Hack through the rusted chain and haul it ashore.
choices.outcome: Inside rests a pouch of stamped silver coins preserved from the bog-rot.

choices.label: Give the knight's bones a proper cairn of stones.
choices.outcome: A quiet stillness settles over the reeds as you honor the forgotten soldier.

text: Mud-caked zealots rise silently from the stagnant pools flanking the plank-walk, swinging rusted sickles and chanting hymns to the Mire.

choices.label: Hold a tight shield-wall on the narrow boards.
choices.outcome: You drive the fanatics back into the deep mire, recovering crude charms and silver.

choices.label: Hurl burning oil onto the marsh-gas bubbles between you.
choices.outcome: A sudden flash of flame scatters the ambushers in panic.

text: A bog-herbalist wading knee-deep in scum waves a lantern at your company, offering stoppered vials of bitter-root tincture.

choices.label: Purchase several vials of the swamp-ague remedy.
choices.outcome: The bitter draught clears the fever-chill from your mercenaries' joints.

choices.label: Trade information about patrol sightings in the fen.
choices.outcome: He points out a dry ridge that bypasses the worst of the leech-beds.

text: Inside the flooded nave of a tilting stone chapel, a dry marble lectern still holds a brass-clasped parish chronicle above the waterline.

choices.label: Wade in and rescue the dry chronicle.
choices.outcome: The entries reveal old tax-caches hidden beneath the dike foundations.

choices.label: Rest briefly on the dry choir-steps out of the fog.
choices.outcome: A short respite restores your company's wind and steadies their nerves.

text: On a rare hummock of firm turf stands an abandoned peat-cutter's brazier still glowing faintly beneath a crust of gray ash.

choices.label: Feed the coals with dry driftwood and tend wounds.
choices.outcome: Thick peat smoke drives off the midges while your vanguard bandages cuts.

choices.label: Search the turf-stacks beside the brazier.
choices.outcome: Hidden inside a hollowed peat block lies a waxed pouch of emergency silver.

text: A rotted section of the raised timber causeway has buckled into the black bog, forcing a choice between wading or rebuilding.

choices.label: Lash fallen logs together to bridge the gap.
choices.outcome: Patient labor carries your heavy gear across without losing a single boot.

choices.label: Wade swiftly through the waist-deep mire.
choices.outcome: You cross quickly, though leeches and cold muck sap your company's vigor.

text: A white-limed quarantine wagon sits mired up to its hubs beside the dike, a sealed apothecary's chest bolted to the driver's bench.

choices.label: Break the wax seal and inspect the chest.
choices.outcome: You recover pristine surgical bandages and heavy silver apothecary weights.

choices.label: Burn the wagon to prevent any lingering blight.
choices.outcome: The quicklime crackles cleanly in the flames as you march on unharmed.

text: Wedged beneath an overhanging basalt ledge above the surf sits a tarred sea-chest marked with a white corsair skull.

choices.label: Pick the salt-crusted lock with a dagger tip.
choices.outcome: Inside lie foreign silver crowns and a flask of potent spiced rum.

choices.label: Smash the lid open with a heavy stone.
choices.outcome: You claim the silver, though a hidden spring-needle nicks your knuckles.

text: Loose shale clatters down the cliffside as rust-corsairs drop from hidden rope-ladders to block the narrow coastal ledge.

choices.label: Push forward into the gap before they form ranks.
choices.outcome: Your sudden assault drives the raiders over the shingle, leaving behind their loot.

choices.label: Pin them down with ranged fire from behind the boulders.
choices.outcome: Pinned against the rock face, the corsairs abandon their gear and scramble up the ropes.

text: A driftwood cross lashed with tarred hemp stands overlooking the crashing reefs, surrounded by piles of bleached crab shells and salt-crystals.

choices.label: Cast a silver coin into the surf in memory of the drowned.
choices.outcome: The howling gale seems to calm, steadying your archers' aim along the cliffs.

choices.label: Gather the dry driftwood for a sheltered windbreak.
choices.outcome: You rest briefly out of the biting spray, though the surf roars louder than before.

text: Clinging to a shattered mast washed onto the shingle is a half-drowned merchant sailor shivering violently in soaked wool.

choices.label: Wrap him in a dry cloak and share warm rations.
choices.outcome: Revived, he guides you to a hidden tide-cave where his captain stashed the ship's strongbox.

choices.label: Point him toward Ironcamp and continue your march.
choices.outcome: He limps northward along the cliff-path while you keep your momentum.

text: At low tide, the barnacle-crusted ribs of a royal patrol galley stand exposed on the sandbar, its stern cabin still intact.

choices.label: Force the swollen cabin door before the tide turns.
choices.outcome: You recover a sealed brass chart-tube and a pouch of naval pay-silver.

choices.label: Salvage dry oak oars and tarred canvas from the deck.
choices.outcome: Sturdy timber and waterproof cloth reinforce your company's packs.

text: Inside the stone lee of a ruined coastal watch-wall, a sheltered fire-pit holds dry kelp and stacked driftwood out of the salt wind.

choices.label: Kindle a warm blaze and oil salt-pitted armor.
choices.outcome: Dry warmth and clean joints restore your vanguard's strength.

choices.label: Keep watch from the parapet through the night.
choices.outcome: Your sentries spot corsair signal-lanterns below, granting you the upper hand ahead.

text: At the bottom of a crystal-clear tidal pool glints a heavy bronze astrolabe wedged between two black basalt boulders.

choices.label: Plunge into the icy brine to pry it loose.
choices.outcome: Shivering from the cold surf, you haul up the valuable navigator's instrument.

choices.label: Use a hooked pole to fish it out from the ledge.
choices.outcome: With patience, you snag the astrolabe without getting a drop of spray on your boots.

text: A blackened marble statue of the First King stands half-buried in gray cinders, its stone hands cupped around a bed of still-warm coals.

choices.label: Scatter the coals with clean water from your canteen.
choices.outcome: Steam rises in a quiet plume, revealing a gilded signet ring fused beneath the ash.

choices.label: Touch your blade to the warm embers in silent oath.
choices.outcome: Fierce resolve steels your company for the final march toward the throne.

text: From behind drifts of gray soot rise three armored pyre-knights, their halberds gleaming dull red in the smoke-choked gloom.

choices.label: Strike hard before they can ignite their braziers.
choices.outcome: A brutal clash shatters their formation, yielding royal silver and tempered steel.

choices.label: Kick up a blinding cloud of ash and flank through the ruins.
choices.outcome: Choking in their heavy helms, the knights miss their swings as you cut them down.

text: Amid the charred ruins of a chancellery wagon sits an iron-bound inquisitor's strongbox, its wax seals melted into red puddles.

choices.label: Force the warped iron lid open.
choices.outcome: Inside rest confiscated noble coins and unburned writs of passage.

choices.label: Burn the remaining treason-lists inside the box.
choices.outcome: Hundreds of condemned names turn to harmless gray flakes in the wind.

text: Slumped against a scorched viaduct pillar is a wounded Ember Guard recruit, his breastplate cracked and his helm lying discarded beside him.

choices.label: Offer him water and bind his scorched shoulder.
choices.outcome: Whispering thanks, he reveals the patrol password for the inner gatehouse.

choices.label: Take his intact steel gauntlets and move on.
choices.outcome: You claim the fine royal metalwork without wasting a drop of water.

text: A soot-covered brick cistern stands beside the blackened road, its heavy bronze inspection hatch wedged half-open by a snapped crowbar.

choices.label: Leverage the hatch fully open and draw fresh water.
choices.outcome: Cool, clean spring water washes the ash from your company's throats and wounds.

choices.label: Check the dry ledges just inside the cistern rim.
choices.outcome: A fleeing citizen hid a leather pouch of gold sovereigns behind the brickwork.

text: Sheltered behind a high wall of cooled foundry slag, a quiet hollow offers rare protection from the stinging ember-wind.

choices.label: Rest behind the slag-wall and sharpen blunted edges.
choices.outcome: A steady respite restores your mercenaries' endurance before the citadel.

choices.label: Sift through the cooling slag heaps for unmelted bullion.
choices.outcome: You pry several lumps of heavy silver out of the glassy black crust.

text: In the center of a cracked marble square lies a fallen cathedral bell, one side melted into rippled bronze by crown-fire.

choices.label: Chip loose chunks of pure bell-bronze.
choices.outcome: Merchants and smiths will pay handsomely for fine consecrated metal.

choices.label: Strike the intact rim with a sword pommel.
choices.outcome: A deep, somber chime rolls across the ash-plains, steadying your vanguard's hearts.

text: Huddled beneath an overturned iron cart is a soot-masked peddler guarding two casks of clean hill-water and cured venison.

choices.label: Pay his steep price for fresh water and cured meat.
choices.outcome: The clean provisions revive your exhausted company completely.

choices.label: Escort him safely back toward the Oakhaven road.
choices.outcome: Relieved to escape the ash-zone, he rewards you with a family heirloom ring.
